name: sol10-caption-spacing
goal: Keep readable separators and same-side metadata in comparison viewer captions.

evidence: The existing catalog preflight at 5792693e42 fails EvidenceViewer captions and the EntityScreens viewer because Svelte trims whitespace at conditional text boundaries.

The standard evidenceViewerActions separator assertion catches this migration defect, but only shared primitives were recorded before the broader catalog preflight. Preserve that assertion and add its visible caption check directly to the existing named catalog case.
Red 572286f5 at 53f140f6f1 fails the unchanged viewer consumer caption assertion; missing separator spaces are observed in rendered markup.
033b33a002 preserves explicit separator spaces in EvidenceViewer without changing side labels, metadata, fixtures or assertions.
Paired green 0fa6c427 at 033b33a002 passes the same single standardized ComparePanes test, paired to red 572286f5 at 53f140f6f1 with identical command, test corpus and environment.
